items.title: 68436_Alberta Hunter oral history interview
items.q: I used to go and sit in their dressing room and talk with them

ctx.x: Uh-huh. Yes. I used to go and sit in their dressing room and talk with them, and Sammy ran out on the stage when he was nothing but a kid, in Boston. We were on the same program. So anytime I write them, if they want to answer, all right, but if they don't, all right. But I want them to know I'm not begging.
